# Quaternius — Ultimate Animated Animals (July 2021)

- Author: Quaternius (https://quaternius.com, https://www.patreon.com/quaternius)
- Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain), see `License.txt` (copied unchanged from the pack).
- Downloaded by the owner on 2026-11-15 (Google Drive zip of the pack).
- In the repo: `art/incoming/quaternius/animals/*.gltf` — 12 models (Alpaca, Bull, Cow, Deer, Donkey, Fox, Horse, Horse_White, Husky, ShibaInu, Stag, Wolf), glTF with embedded buffers, no textures (material colours), 12-13 animations each (Attack, Death, Eating, Gallop, Gallop_Jump, Idle, Idle_2, Idle_2_HeadLow, Idle_HitReact1/2, Jump_ToIdle, Walk, ...). The pack's FBX / OBJ / .blend copies are not stored.

# Quaternius — Ultimate Stylized Nature (May 2022)

- Author: Quaternius. Licence: CC0 1.0 (public domain), see `License_UltimateStylizedNature.txt` (copied unchanged; its header line says "Ultimate Platformer Pack", a copy-paste slip in the pack, the licence is the same CC0).
- Downloaded by the owner on 2026-11-15 (Google Drive zip of the pack).
- `art/incoming/quaternius/nature/gltf/`: the pack's whole glTF folder, 36 models (BirchTree_1-5, MapleTree_1-5, DeadTree_1-10, Bush x6, Flower x7, Grass_Large / _Large_Extruded / _Small) as .gltf + .bin, plus the 21 textures. The 5 `*_Normal.png` normal maps were re-saved as RGB PNG (their alpha was 255 everywhere): pixels identical, ~94 MB -> ~21 MB.
- `art/incoming/quaternius/nature/fbx/`: the 27 models the pack has NO glTF for (NormalTree_1-5, PineTree_1-5, PalmTree_1-5, Rock_1-5, Petals_1-4, Plant_1, Plant_2, Plant_Flowers). These FBX files carry material names only, no texture links: their textures (NormalTree_*, PineTree_*, PalmTree_*, Rocks.jpg, Leaves_BW, Flowers) are in the `gltf/` folder.
- Not stored: OBJ, .blend, `AllModels.blend`, Preview.jpg, the duplicate `Textures/` folder.
